name: Dream Imp Companion (3pp)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
This squat little furry creature has bat wings attached to its arms. It chortles while digging through scraps in search of useful tools.

Dream imp companion art by Raynaldo Perez. Used with permission.

Dream Imp Companion CR 1

DEFENSEXP 400
NG small dragon
Init +2; Senses dragon senses; Perception +7

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 size)
hp 15 (2d12+2)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +4 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks breath weapon (20 ft. cone, 2d8 electricity, DC 12, usable every 1d4 rounds)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 14
Base Atk +2; CMB +2; CMD 14
Feats Cooperative Crafting
Skills Appraise +7, Craft (any one) +7, Heal +7, Knowledge (arcana) +7, Perception +7, Perform +7, Spellcraft +7, Use Magic Device +7
Languages Common, Draconic, Elven
SQ scavenge

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Scavenge (Ex)

A dream imp often collects scraps of leftover materials from crafting. Once per week, the dream imp can treat a failed craft check by 5 or more as a failure by 4 or less instead. It can provide this benefit to any creature it helps with cooperative crafting. A creature cannot benefit from scavenge more than once per week, even if it has help from multiple dream imps.

Additional Information

Monstorin Racial Traits
Available trainer spells
